Messrs [Thomas Constable & Co](/organisation/136)with Compliments to Miss Yonge beg to send her herewith three copies of the new edition of [Tom Thumb](/book/21).[[f Should Miss Yonge require more they will be happy to send a farther supply on hearing from her.
